_comment: Scene families of the demo besides the built-in Wildtrack and MultiviewX (see kinds.py). To add a scene,
copy this entry: the Dataset tab opens every existing folder of 'datasets', checkpoints whose log / path
names the key or an alias (or, when loaded with + Checkpoint, that have this many cameras) run on it, and
'live' adds it to the Live tab's Unity scene list.
grid: cells along world X (x) and Y (y), positionID = gx + x * gy; origin and unit of the calibration;
indexing = how the checkpoints' BEV rows run (xy: rows = world Y, as MultiviewX; ij: rows = world X).
live.unity_axes maps a Unity direction (x, y, z) to the dataset world frame (rows: world X, Y, Z).
A built-in key (wildtrack / multiviewx) may be listed to add datasets, aliases or a live entry to it.
